[CONTRIBUTION EVENT]
- Type: Time (Minutes)
- Amount: 150
- Description: Governor direction — Indonesia (Rusmin) inspection directive redaction and issue readiness
  
  Pull requests (GitHub evidence):
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1894
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1896
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1897
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1899
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1900
  
  Details:
  Gary's time directing the Indonesia (Rusmin) site inspection directive across five PDF revisions — review, redaction calls, and issue-readiness judgement.
  
  GOVERNOR INTERVENTIONS THAT CHANGED THE DOCUMENT
  1. Branding — "don't mention TrueSight DAO in the PDF". Repeated three times before it landed. The string was in PDF document metadata (`author: TrueSight DAO Autopilot`), not page text, so text-based checks kept reporting it clean. Drove the switch to a raw-byte verification standard.
  2. "3, 4, 5 are internal commentaries" — correctly identified the three sections that had no business in a partner-facing document. Cutting them exposed a fourth leak (our lab invoice number, lot name and purchase date) embedded in the section above.
  3. Cost-basis and freight judgement — flagged the tension between keeping the benchmark column useful and not handing a prospective supplier our paid rates pre-negotiation.
  4. Internal-path exposure — flagged that the document carried ~10 internal repo references including our cost basis.
  5. Issue readiness — drove the sequence to a verified final version and instructing closure of the Jira work.
  
  WHY THIS WAS MORE THAN EDITING
  Each intervention resolved a different class of leakage: branding, commercial exposure, drafting-process narrative, and internal tooling paths. The governor's repeated branding push was the one that surfaced the metadata blind spot — three failures of the same check before the right verification method was found.
  
  OUTCOME
  8-page directive, verified clean on body text and raw bytes, attached to KAN-8 and KAN-80, both closed Done.
- Contributor(s): Gary Teh
- TDG Issued: 250.00
- Attached Filename: N/A
- Destination Contribution File Location: N/A
